title: He Got Rich Off AMD at $2. He's Buying These Stocks Next.
creator: MarketBeat
summary: MarketBeat interviews Matt McCall of Monument Traders Alliance, who made his name buying AMD at $2 and now pitches five beaten-down high-growth names for the next AI wave, arguing money will rotate from mega-caps toward mid and small caps. His blue-chip robotics pick is Teradyne (TER), where semiconductor testing drives growth of roughly 130% in earnings in 2026 and robotics and cobots are cheap upside at a double or triple bottom. Grail (GRAL) is his high-risk play: its Galleri blood test screens for more than 50 cancers, FDA approval is expected in early 2027 and Medicare coverage would be the bigger catalyst, with 10-bagger or takeover potential. Kratos Defense (KTOS) is a future-of-warfare hedge in unmanned aircraft, with a rising defence budget and a return to fair value worth a double. FormFactor (FORM) is picks-and-shovels for quantum — cryogenic testing is needed whoever wins — profitable at about 20% growth, a P/E in the low 20s and a PEG near 1. Fabrinet (FN) covers AI photonics and optics for data centres, down about 11% over a year despite earnings. All five are buys on pullbacks, with no share prices stated and all first tracked for MarketBeat.

calls.video_title: He Got Rich Off AMD at $2. He’s Buying These Stocks Next.
calls.thesis: BUY (first tracked for MarketBeat; guest Matt McCall) — Teradyne as his blue-chip robotics play and first name to add to a robotics portfolio; great entry point on the pullback at a double/triple bottom. Semi testing drives growth, robotics/cobots are a cheap add-on with upside. No price stated.
calls.base_case: Earnings growth ~130% in 2026 and ~30% in following years; revenue growth ~61% this year on semi testing strength.
calls.bull_case: Robotics grows faster from a low base and could help Teradyne become a much larger — he says potential trillion-dollar — company; a 20-bagger in his framing.

calls.video_title: He Got Rich Off AMD at $2. He’s Buying These Stocks Next.
calls.thesis: BUY (first tracked for MarketBeat; guest Matt McCall) — Grail buy-and-hold high-risk play: Galleri blood test screens for 50+ cancers from stage zero; FDA committee was positive 26 Sep, approval expected early 2027. No price stated.
calls.base_case: Approval in Q1 2027 is likely in his view; a ~$5bn company could reach ~$20bn (4x) if the test becomes routine for over-50s.
calls.bull_case: Medicare coverage would open floodgates; he calls it a potential 10-bagger in a few years and a likely takeover target (e.g. J&J).
calls.bear_case: Expect major volatility — it lost ~50% in a week in the last year before rising ~4x from the bottom; approval/Medicare are not certain.

calls.video_title: He Got Rich Off AMD at $2. He’s Buying These Stocks Next.
calls.thesis: BUY (first tracked for MarketBeat; guest Matt McCall) — Kratos Defense as a future-of-warfare hedge: unmanned aircraft between drones and jets, converging robotics/AI/sensors; thesis intact despite the chart, and a return to fair value is a double in his view. No price stated.
calls.base_case: Defence budget rising from ~$1tn to ~$1.5tn, with drone allocation sharply higher; Kratos already has many government contracts including a recent one.
calls.bear_case: Drone group has pulled back hard after a speculative top (multiple drone ETFs launched); he advises owning 3-4 drone names rather than one.

calls.video_title: He Got Rich Off AMD at $2. He’s Buying These Stocks Next.
calls.thesis: BUY (first tracked for MarketBeat; guest Matt McCall) — FormFactor (FORM, stated) as picks-and-shovels on quantum computing: one of few firms that can test at cryogenic temperatures needed by 2 of 3 quantum approaches, so the winner does not matter. Profitable, unlike most quantum names. No price stated.
calls.base_case: ~20% YoY growth, P/E in low 20s, PEG ~1 — better than the market; core business is AI/semi testing, quantum is growing and still a small share.
calls.bull_case: Quantum use cases from ~2030 and mainstream by ~2035, married with AI, would expand demand for its testing.

calls.video_title: He Got Rich Off AMD at $2. He’s Buying These Stocks Next.
calls.thesis: BUY (first tracked for MarketBeat; guest Matt McCall) — Fabrinet (FN, stated) AI infrastructure in photonics/optics for data centres; $13bn company, pulled back and down ~11% over a year despite earnings, giving a great opportunity to add/double down. No price stated.
calls.base_case: Data-centre/compute demand is a no-brainer in his view; Fabrinet is a leader with contracts and the story is unchanged, only the price has fallen.
calls.bull_case: He frames this as a 1995 internet moment, not 1999 — infrastructure builders like Cisco then won as the build-out continued.
calls.bear_case: AI-bubble and data-centre financing doubts are weighing on the group; holders are down from highs and volatility is high.
